item.title: Ta kala modolongo molwokudenga ‘nyamunghwawo’

item.title: A ningila omonakadona omatilifo noku mu kwata onghonga
item.description: Opolifi moshitukulwa shaMusati otai konakona oshibofa shomulumenhu vati a kwatwa okaana kaye keedula omu-17 onghonga lwoikando ya yooloka.
